metadata.title: Polynomial approximations to Calabi--Yau metrics on quartic K3 surfaces and quintic threefolds
metadata.abstract: On the Fermat quartic K3 surface and the Fermat quintic threefold, we construct Kähler metrics from explicit rational polynomial potentials and bound their differences from the Ricci-flat metrics in integral tensor norms. For specified compact families of smooth quartic and quintic hypersurfaces near the Fermat hypersurfaces, we give a terminating algorithm that constructs polynomial Kähler metrics with prescribed pointwise bounds on their differences from the Ricci-flat metrics and on their Ricci forms. The resulting metrics converge to the Ricci-flat metrics in every $C^r$ norm, uniformly in the parameter.
